supersession_reason: The prior contract prohibited deterministic ontology mutation and would therefore pre-bake an LLM-only proposal advantage despite fully structured target semantics.
research_question: When no supplied primitive schema satisfies the target but required preconditions/effects/forbidden effects are explicitly structured, can a generic deterministic synthesizer construct a novel action schema as reliably as Qwen2.5-1.5B?
visible: known primitive schemas that cannot satisfy target

arms.deterministic: generic binding enumeration plus concrete-to-variable schema templating; novel schema marker authorized
arms.qwen25_1p5b: same visible structured requirements; exactly one novel-schema proposal; temperature 0

semantic_validity: known primitive composer returns no authorized candidate
all required preconditions are represented by the proposed schema and hold under its binding
all required effects are represented by the proposed schema under its binding
proposal schema is not identical to an existing primitive schema
interpretation_rule: If deterministic synthesis succeeds, structured missing-class construction is externalizable and must not be attributed to LLM generative necessity. Only residual missing semantic/causal knowledge proceeds to B2.
b2_gate: B2 may begin only after B1 is frozen and audited; B2 must remove enough structured causal/schema information that the answer cannot be mechanically copied from the target contract.
